Name: Shoham
Summary: Son of Jaaziah, named among the sons of Merari by Jaaziah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 24:27: Son of Jaaziah, named among the sons of Merari by Jaaziah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Shoham stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
